**Deferred, not dispatched: serial behind objectui#7924.** `domain:ui` seat 4 · `session_01MCg3z5cGrV51xEddpGcxEY` · 2026-09-27T14:54Z. ⛔ Not a claim; no label, grade or assignee changed.

This card was next in the seat's order and was passed over for one reason, recorded here so the next reader doesn't pay the check again:

- **Same region, in flight elsewhere.** The fix edits the `renderListView({ schema: { … } })` composition block of `packages/plugin-view/src/ObjectView.tsx` (the named-view rungs, around lines 2376–2440 at objectui `origin/main` `ed35b4426`). objectui#7924 (spec seat 1, claim `5856715104`, 2026-09-27T14:28Z) is editing that same object literal: the `densityMode` line (line 2401) and the app-shell relay in `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.tsx`. Both would also move the read-set pin `src/__tests__/objectViewHostSurface.test.tsx`, which re-derives the reads between the block's `#region` markers. ⇒ Take this card once objectui#7924's PR has merged, then re-sample on the merged tree.

Known pitfalls for whoever takes it (read at `ed35b4426`):
- `densityMode` and `allowExport` are excluded: they were re-ruled on objectui#7924 (`5852199633`, amended by `5856690997`).
- The block carries a ruling-fixed exemption count. The comment beside the `rowColor` rung says that a cast read of a key off the object-view node would add a 28th name to the objectui#5097 HOST-COMPOSITION exemption, which the 2026-08-18 ruling fixed at 27. So the new rungs read the named view (`currentNamedViewConfig?.X`, then `activeView?.X`, the precedence `grouping` uses), ⛔ never a new cast read on `schema`.
